image_description: A close-up, low-angle shot of a vintage black hot rod car. The primary focus is on the front left wheel and tire assembly, with the rear left wheel also visible in the background. The car features a glossy black fender, a chrome grille, and a red engine component visible through the open wheel well. The wheels are custom alloy rims with a polished finish and deep-dish design, mounted with low-profile black rubber tires.
